column1: # tools/lockrig/hosts.example.tsv -- EXAMPLE lock/saver/greeter test-rig host inventory.
# The real inventory is site-local and never committed: lockrig reads, in order,
# $LOCKRIG_HOSTS, ~/.config/ncz/lockrig-hosts.tsv, tools/lockrig/hosts.tsv (git-ignored),
# and only then this example (documentation addresses, RFC 5737). Copy it and edit.
# Tab-separated. Columns (order is load-bearing):
#   name           short logical name used on the lockrig command line
#   ip             management address (operator workstation -> host)
#   arch           amd64 | arm64
#   user           ssh login (test hosts: ncz / build hosts: your build user)
#   display        1 = a DRM output is connected and a graphical session can run; 0 = none
#   geometry       expected panel/logical size, or 'auto' to probe at runtime, or '-' if headless
#   gpu            GPU description
#   attended       1 = a human is physically at the machine -> needs --allow-attended,
#                  and the host is run LAST, one at a time, with a short lock window
#   headless       0 = run the live lock/saver/greeter cases; 1 = run the headless
#                  labwc harness against installed binaries instead (no compositor/DRM)
#   notes          free text
# The address/arch/user/attended/headless columns are load-bearing; geometry is a hint.
# Add a host: append one line to your local inventory.
# --- test machines running the candidate image ----------------------------------------
prime-laptop
sky1-board
